name: Physarum grokcf1
description: An advanced, agent-based slime mold simulation with emergent, time-driven growth patterns, complex nutrient interaction, and mouse-driven agent spawning. Upgraded: agents now live in the feedback texture so the network actually grows; the mold forages along the photo's edges, veins show a cyan gel rim over a dark core, and cytoplasm streams in bands that reverse every couple of seconds.
